responsibility: This file translates Fortran I/O statements into calls on libgfortran’s runtime I/O interface. It builds the compiler-side parameter-record types described by ioparm.def, caches the runtime entry declarations for READ/WRITE/OPEN/CLOSE/INQUIRE/WAIT and data-transfer helpers, marshals statement tags and item metadata into those records, and lowers scalar, array, derived-type, and namelist transfers—either by passing descriptors directly or scalarizing elementwise—so parsed gfc_code I/O nodes become executable runtime-call sequences.
